description.title: שירותי דרך – גלגל חלופי
description.summary: This table details the terms of wheel replacement and towing services provided as part of a vehicle assistance package. It outlines conditions for service, and the deductible amount.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי שירות החלפת גלגל ושירותי גרירה הכלולים בחבילת סיוע לרכב. השירות ניתן כאשר הרכב מכיל גלגל רזרבי תקין, וחלקיו תקינים. במקרה של רכב המגיע ללא גלגל רזרבי מהיצרן, יינתן שירות גרירה למוסך הקרוב ביותר. במקרה של הפעלת השירות, המקבל ישלם השתתפות עצמית בסך 59 ש״ח כולל מע״מ. שירותי דרך כוללים החלפת גלגל או גרירה. שירותי דרך ניתנים על ידי ספק השירות.

3.2 Wheel replacement service
In order to replace a wheel, a representative on behalf of the service provider shall arrive at the vehicle and replace the wheel on site.
3.2.1 Service details
The service detailed hereunder shall be provided to the service recipient by the service provider as follows:
A representative on behalf of the service provider will arrive at the site where the vehicle which is entitled to the service is located and replace the punctured wheel with the spare wheel kept in the vehicle, only if:
The vehicle contains a spare wheel which is in proper working order.
The parts of the replaced wheels and their components (nuts and bolts) are in proper working order.
3.2.2 In any event of a punctured wheel, in the event that the vehicle arrives from the manufacturer without a spare wheel, the towing service will be provided up to the puncture repair shop nearest to the vehicle which is entitled to the service.
3.2.3 Deductible
In any event of provision or activation of the services provided under this service document, the service recipient will pay a deductible in a sum of NIS 59 (fifty-nine shekels) including V.A.T. The payment will be made to the service provider actually providing the services, upon receipt thereof.
